# deposit.now

> deposit.now — open x402 agent funding rail (USDC on Base and Solana). Pay 0.25% (min $0.001, max $0.25) over HTTP 402; net forwards to any Base or Solana target — or provision a managed child wallet with provision:true (Base). Optional public receipt. Complements Coinbase CDP Fund/Send.

Homepage: https://deposit.now · Docs: https://deposit.now/docs  
Machine contracts: https://deposit.now/openapi.json · https://deposit.now/llms-full.txt · Discovery: https://deposit.now/api/discovery

## Honest pitch

- deposit.now is a **protocol-shaped deposit API** plus optional **managed child wallets**.
- Coinbase Agentic / Server Wallets already include **Fund** and **Send**. Use those if you live fully in CDP.
- Use deposit.now when a paying agent should fund **any Base or Solana address** via **x402** without a deposit.now API key — or create+fund a child address in one call (Base).

## Who needs what

- Paying agent: any x402 client + USDC on Base (`@x402/evm`) or Solana (`@x402/svm`). No deposit.now API key. AgentKit optional, not required.
- Target: any Base EVM or Solana address you already have, **or** set provision:true to mint a managed CDP child wallet (Base only).
- Managed children: keys stay in deposit.now’s CDP project (platform_managed). v1 does **not** export keys or offer child spend APIs. For full custody, generate your own address and pass target.
- Platform (server): CDP for hot wallet receive/forward + child provision; optional Blob for public receipts.
- Humans on the website: docs only — no connect-wallet required to use the API.

## Networks (USDC)

Pay the 402 **on the same chain as `target`**. The 402 `accepts` list includes both; pick the matching one.

| Chain | CAIP-2 | USDC | When |
|-------|--------|------|------|
| Base mainnet | `eip155:8453` | `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913` | `target` is `0x…` or `provision:true` |
| Solana mainnet | `solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp` | `EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v` | `target` is a Solana address |

- 0x EVM address → pay + forward on Base
- Solana base58 address → pay + forward on Solana
- `provision:true` → Base only (managed CDP child)
- Paying the other chain is held (`CHAIN_MISMATCH`) — no bridge

Client packages: `@x402/evm` (Base) · `@x402/svm` (Solana)

## Core API

- POST https://deposit.now/api/deposit
- Body (JSON):
  - amount: net USDC to forward (decimal string, min 0.01, max 100000) — **required**
  - target: Base EVM or Solana address receiving net USDC — **required unless provision**
  - provision: true — create/resolve managed child wallet (do not send target)
  - label: stable child id (e.g. trading-agent-1) — **required with provision** unless Idempotency-Key header
  - memo: optional string (max 256)
- Header (optional): Idempotency-Key — stable provision identity
- Price: amount + 0.25% platform fee, $0.001 min, $0.25 max (agent pays gross via x402; fee always under the ~$0.32 average x402 payment)
- Unpaid → HTTP 402 + Payment-Required (includes target + child when provisioned)
- Paid → 200 with status **payment_received** (not a guarantee that target already holds funds)
- Forward to target is **async after settlement** and can fail — check receiptUrl / forwardStatus

## Example — fund existing address (Base)

{"target":"0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc9e7595f0bEb0","amount":"50.00","memo":"optional note"}

## Example — fund existing address (Solana)

{"target":"<solana-address>","amount":"50.00","memo":"optional note"}

## Example — provision + fund child

{"provision":true,"label":"trading-agent-1","amount":"50.00","memo":"Fund child trading agent"}

## Agent pays with JavaScript (Base)

    npm install @x402/fetch @x402/core @x402/evm viem

    import { wrapFetchWithPayment } from '@x402/fetch';
    import { x402Client } from '@x402/core/client';
    import { ExactEvmScheme } from '@x402/evm/exact/client';
    import { privateKeyToAccount } from 'viem/accounts';

    const signer = privateKeyToAccount(process.env.EVM_PRIVATE_KEY); // paying agent only
    const client = new x402Client();
    client.register('eip155:*', new ExactEvmScheme(signer));
    const fetchWithPayment = wrapFetchWithPayment(fetch, client);

    const res = await fetchWithPayment('https://deposit.now/api/deposit', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        target: '0x742d35Cc6634C0532925a3b844Bc9e7595f0bEb0',
        amount: '50.00',
      }),
    });
    console.log(await res.json()); // payment_received + receiptUrl

## Agent pays with JavaScript (Solana)

    npm install @x402/fetch @x402/core @x402/svm

    import { wrapFetchWithPayment } from '@x402/fetch';
    import { x402Client } from '@x402/core/client';
    import { ExactSvmScheme } from '@x402/svm/exact/client';

    const client = new x402Client();
    client.register('solana:*', new ExactSvmScheme(svmSigner)); // paying-agent Solana signer
    const fetchWithPayment = wrapFetchWithPayment(fetch, client);

    const res = await fetchWithPayment('https://deposit.now/api/deposit', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        target: '<solana-address>',
        amount: '50.00',
      }),
    });
    console.log(await res.json()); // payment_received + receiptUrl

- GET https://deposit.now/api/discovery
- GET https://deposit.now/.well-known/x402
- GET https://deposit.now/openapi.json
- GET https://deposit.now/llms.txt
- GET https://deposit.now/llms-full.txt
- GET https://deposit.now/receipt/{id}

## Facts

- Settlement payTo (platform): 0x96da70311D3fDb8500B9AB0855E17F213dB0C9AA (Base). Solana payTo is the CDP account named `deposit-now-platform` (override with CDP_PLATFORM_SOLANA_ADDRESS).
- Facilitator: Coinbase CDP x402 (mainnet) — Base + Solana
- Contact: support@deposit.now
